name: expertise_tags
description: Diaspora expertise taxonomy. Each tag names a capability a diaspora professional can offer to the bilateral relationship, and maps to exactly one code in sectors.json. Tags describe capability, not job title - a tag should answer 'what could this person be asked to do'. Codes are stable; labels may be edited.

expertise_tags.label: Lithium and Battery-Materials Processing Engineering
expertise_tags.description: Hydrometallurgical and pyrometallurgical processing of spodumene and lithium brines to battery-grade carbonate and hydroxide; plant design, flowsheet development, commissioning and operations. HERO TAG - the demo's diaspora search must return a profile carrying this tag.

expertise_tags.label: Migration Pathway and Education Policy Research
expertise_tags.description: Academic and policy expertise in skilled-migration systems, occupation-list design, qualification recognition, student-to-skilled transition, and the labour-market and ethical-recruitment effects of migration policy. HERO TAG - paired with XP_LITHIUM_PROCESSING_ENG in the demo's dual-sector result.

expertise_tags.label: Mineral Economics and Resource Policy
expertise_tags.description: Commodity market analysis, resource taxation and royalty design, beneficiation policy, and the economics of domestic-processing mandates.

expertise_tags.label: Exploration Geology and Resource Estimation
expertise_tags.description: Greenfield and brownfield exploration, geophysical interpretation, drilling programmes, and resource and reserve estimation to internationally recognised reporting standards.

expertise_tags.label: Extractive Metallurgy and Metallurgical Testwork
expertise_tags.description: Comminution, flotation, leaching and separation testwork; scale-up from bench to pilot to plant.

expertise_tags.label: Mine Engineering and Operations
expertise_tags.description: Open-pit and underground mine design, scheduling, ventilation, geotechnical engineering, and operational readiness.

expertise_tags.label: Mine Safety Systems and Standards
expertise_tags.description: Occupational health and safety systems, incident investigation, regulatory compliance and safety culture programmes for resource operations.

expertise_tags.label: Artisanal Mining Formalisation
expertise_tags.description: Transitioning artisanal and small-scale mining into formal, traceable and safer operations: cooperative structuring, mercury reduction, and supply-chain due diligence.

expertise_tags.label: Minerals Traceability and Responsible Sourcing

expertise_tags.label: Resources Project Finance
expertise_tags.description: Structuring and financing of mining and processing projects: offtake-backed debt, streaming, development finance and political-risk mitigation.

expertise_tags.label: Technical and Vocational Curriculum Design

expertise_tags.label: Qualification Assessment and Recognition
expertise_tags.description: Comparative qualification assessment, competency mapping and occupational licensing pathways across the two jurisdictions.

expertise_tags.label: Higher Education Partnership Development
expertise_tags.description: Articulation and dual-award agreements, transnational education delivery models, quality assurance and accreditation across jurisdictions.

expertise_tags.label: Research Programme Management
expertise_tags.description: Design and administration of joint research programmes: funding architecture, intellectual property arrangements, mobility schemes and research integrity.

expertise_tags.label: STEM Education and Workforce Pipeline

expertise_tags.label: Dryland Agronomy and Crop Science

expertise_tags.label: Livestock Genetics and Animal Health

expertise_tags.label: Post-Harvest Systems and Cold Chain

expertise_tags.label: Food Safety and Export Standards

expertise_tags.label: Renewable Energy Engineering

expertise_tags.label: Gas Processing and Utilisation

expertise_tags.label: Power Systems Planning and Regulation

expertise_tags.label: Software Engineering and Platform Architecture

expertise_tags.label: Data Science and Applied AI

expertise_tags.label: Structural and Civil Engineering
